Name: Bonster's Garden Farm
Author: rjgilber
Description:
Do you like trees? Sure you do! We all do! Do you like a lot of trees? This might be the map for you!

And if it isn't, there's a second version included which does away with the specialized tree area, although why you would want to do that confuses me (maybe because you don't have a simply stupendous number of trees to grow).  The base map features:
* A formal garden area
* Tillable grass
* Pretty flowers (thanks to Eemie's flowers)
* An organized tree area for people who like to keep things sorted
* Random surprises and custom statues
* A grass labyrinth for personal meditative moments (which will probably be covered with livestock grass, if we're honest)
* Maps are seasonal
* Plenty of room for many years of growth.


If you would rather not have the organized tree area, there's a second map in the file called Farm_Forage2. Simple delete Farm_Forage and then erase the 2, so the file is now called Farm_Forage.  You will now have an open, rather plain grassy area.  

To install, download, unzip and drop into your mod folder.  Choose forest map when starting your game (or, if you're already playing using the forest map, it will show up in the game for you).  Let me know in the comments what you like (or would change)!
